Type this code on the new device: Settings → Backup → Enter a code. The code works once and expires in 24 hours.
The backup will be deleted. If this device is reset or the app is reinstalled, there will be nothing to restore from.

We recommend VLC and Vimu — they work reliably."
Which app opens the video. Pick one — the system “always” setting stops getting in the way.
Off — the app uses its built-in engine

Keep torrents in the server database
A started title stays in your server list — you can continue it from a phone without searching for the same release. Turn on only for your own server.
Play through your own server instead of the built-in engine

Featured titles above the rows on Home, Movies and Series.

Show IMDb ratings instead of TMDB and order “Best of” rows by them. Titles IMDb does not know stay without a badge.
Update on their own once a week. Press to update now.
The same release lives on several trackers. Off — one row with the highest seed count.
Match the screen refresh rate to the movie. The screen blinks briefly when playback starts.
This device does not let apps change the screen refresh rate.
Ask when the preferred voiceover is missing
Lifts quiet dialogue and tames loud scenes. Has no effect when Audio output is set to Passthrough: there the volume is handled by the receiver.
Compatibility decodes audio to stereo (fixes DTS buzzing / missing dialogue on TV boxes). Passthrough sends multichannel/DTS to a receiver.

In-memory buffer. «Auto» picks the size by device memory: from 48 MB on weak (~1 GB) to 128 MB on powerful ones. Larger is smoother, but very large values can cause stutter or crashes on weak devices.
Do not downgrade 4K and 10-bit, even if the box is detected as weak.
Flux looks at the decoder and word size of your box itself.
Never pick heavy releases automatically, even if the box copes with them.

4K, 10-bit and very high bitrate are not for every box: such video stutters and freezes after a pause. This is not a filter — the torrent list and the \"Quality\" panel always show everything; heavy ones just sink to the bottom and get a warning.
Not available with an external player
Not available with an external TorrServe
Does nothing right now: «Heavy releases» is set to «Avoid», or this box has no hardware 4K decoder.
Heavy remuxes are skipped — they rarely download fast enough. If no 4K fits, Flux steps down to 1080p and says so.

Flux will not start anything worse when there is something better to pick. If nothing at that quality exists — or such torrents have almost no seeds — it starts the best available and says so. The torrent list and the «Quality» panel keep showing everything either way.

Rows and menus slide instead of jumping. TVs usually switch animations off — Flux brings them back.
For a movie the list appears every time; for a series only on the first episode, then episodes start with the remembered torrent.
What happens when you press Watch
Picks by speed, quality and what your device can handle, then starts the video with no list. Works only with the built-in player and the built-in TorrServe.
Which section opens at startup. Back and exit still go through Home.
Which section opens when you start the app. Back still leads to Home, and the app is still closed from there.
A plate behind the text. Off — only the text (with outline); translucent or solid — for a busy picture.
A black outline around the letters — keeps subtitles readable over any video without a background plate.
Text size as a share of the screen. Larger sizes help when watching in the original language or with low vision.

Share the pieces you already have. Without upload you get fewer peers, and releases play slower.
